source_findings.finding: Wrong typed optional db_path and expected_sha256 collapse to absent via get_string or s_opt. Exact field whitelist alone does not enforce schemas.
source_findings.fix: Distinguish absent, present with allowed type, and invalid present for every optional field. Refuse before mutation.

source_findings.finding: Yojson accepts malformed raw UTF8; decoded values and summaries are not checked for valid UTF8 JSON.
source_findings.fix: Validate UTF8 scalar bytes and strict JSON syntax, including duplicate keys and special floats/tuple/extensions; retain Gleam ownership of domain schema.

source_findings.finding: check_ancestor_paths checks foreign-writable bits only when st_uid differs from current UID and permits every sticky root directory, rather than exact /tmp exception.
source_findings.fix: Enforce non-foreign-writable permissions for all ancestors irrespective of trusted owner, except exact root-owned sticky /tmp; immediate private directory remains0700.

source_findings.finding: Initialization tx_body exceptions escape without explicit rollback; statement finalization is not protected on all exception/bind failures. Main catch reports generic sqlite_error even for exceptional commit paths.
source_findings.fix: Protect transaction rollback and statement finalize, track commit ambiguity conservatively. Process always closes/reaps before any caller reconciliation.

source_findings.finding: Tests use boolean simulated commit results; no observed process kill within DDL/meta/row transactions or post-COMMIT pre-reply. Required crash acceptance remains UNRUN.
source_findings.fix: Test-only stage hook inaccessible from CLI/JSON/environment, child pipes and SIGKILL barriers at init schema/meta, apply row, precommit and postcommit; reopen old or fully new state/receipt.
